mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product) AS product_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS order_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) AS customer_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE status = 2) AS order_pending_ship, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 1) AS product_online, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon WHERE status = 1) AS coupon_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seckill WHERE status = 1) AS seckill_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE status = 0) AS customer_disabled

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, COALESCE(c.nickname, c.username) AS customer_name, o.pay_amount, o.status, o.created_at FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT pc.id, pc.name, COALESCE(SUM(p.sales), 0) AS sales FROM product_category pc LEFT JOIN product p ON p.category_id = pc.id GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10
